# Travelo Japan

> > Travelo Japan offers curated tour packages and travel experiences across Japan, from Tokyo city tours to UNESCO heritage sites, regional adventures in Hokkaido, Kyoto, and remote destinations.

The site specializes in multi-day tours, day trips, and activity packages covering major cities like Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, and Nara, as well as off-the-beaten-path destinations including pilgrimage routes, ski resorts, and island getaways. Hotel booking services are also available for select properties.

## Key Topics

- Japan tour packages
- Tokyo sightseeing
- Hokkaido winter tours
- Kyoto and Nara temples
- UNESCO heritage sites
- Multi-day tours (2-day packages)
- Day trips from Tokyo
- Nature and hiking tours
- Cultural activities (karaoke, ninja training)
- Ski resorts (Niseko)
- Pilgrimage routes (Kumano Kodo)
- Island destinations (Shodoshima, Sado)
- Historical sites (Tomioka Silk Mill)
- Regional tours (Gunma, Wakayama, Niigata)
- Hotel booking services

## Major City Tours

- [Tokyo Sightseeing | Tokyo Sightseeing Packages](https://www.travelojapan.com/sightseeing/tokyo-packages): Tokyo sightseeing packages: Mount Takao, Roppongi day tours
- [Nagoya Tours](https://www.travelojapan.com/tours/nagoya-packages): Nagoya tours: Kiso Valley, Nakasendo trail eco-tour packages
- [Uji | Book Uji Tour Packages](https://www.travelojapan.com/places-to-visit/uji): Uji historical temples and shrines tour near Kyoto and Nara

## UNESCO Heritage & Historical Sites

- [Tomioka Silk Mill Tour | Gunma Sightseeing Packages](https://www.travelojapan.com/sightseeing/tomioka-silk-mill-tour): UNESCO heritage Tomioka Silk Mill day trip from Tokyo in Gunma
- [Kumano Kodo (old Passage) | Book Kumano Kodo Tour Packages](https://www.travelojapan.com/places-to-visit/kumano-kodo-old-passage): Kumano Kodo pilgrimage routes tour packages in Wakayama, Kii Peninsula

## Hokkaido & Northern Japan

- [Niseko | Book Niseko Tour Packages](https://www.travelojapan.com/places-to-visit/niseko): Niseko Hokkaido ski resort: powder snow, snowboarding, winter sports
- [Abashiri Tour Packages](https://www.travelojapan.com/tours/abashiri-tour): Hokkaido Abashiri winter drift ice tours and prison museum packages
- [Matsushima Tours](https://www.travelojapan.com/tours/matsushima-packages): Matsushima Bay scenic hiking tours in Tohoku region, 2-day packages

## Island & Coastal Destinations

- [Things To Do in Shodoshima | Shodoshima Activities Packages](https://www.travelojapan.com/activities/shodoshima-packages): Shodoshima island activities: swimming, surfing in Seto Inland Sea
- [Sado Island Tour Packages](https://www.travelojapan.com/tours/sado-island-tour): Sado Island Niigata tours: gold mountain, Senkaku Bay, sake tasting

## Activities & Experiences

- [Japan Karaoke Packages | Book Japan Tour Packages](https://www.travelojapan.com/activities/karaoke-travel-packages): Japan karaoke activity packages in Tokyo, Osaka, and Nara
- [Things To Do in Mie | Mie Activities Packages](https://www.travelojapan.com/activities/mie-packages): Mie activities: ninja training at Akame 48 Waterfalls packages
- [Things To Do in Yamanashi | Yamanashi Activities Packages](https://www.travelojapan.com/activities/yamanashi-packages): Yamanashi fruit picking activities in Kofu and Enzan regions
